title: The app restarts between an open ask and the turn that does it
expected: The recap survives the restart without a model request, and the tracking leaves the not-addressed list once it is wired up. No request is listed twice.

steps.user: Add a 'reorder' button to past orders, and track clicks on it in analytics.

steps.agent: The reorder button is on each past order and refills the cart with the same items. Analytics tracking is not wired up yet.

check.why: the recap is read back from disk
tracking is asked for and not done yet
a restart alone asks the model nothing (turn 1 took one request and one repair)

steps.agent: Clicks on reorder now send a reorder_clicked event with the order id.

check.why: nothing the user asked for is left unaddressed
the tracking is recorded as done
